notes: The web page is the build for the files you already have: the tool cards that fetched songs are not part of it, and Discover’s how-to now opens at + Add songs → + Files.
The full web app is one link away: /full opens this same page with the Spotify, YouTube, MP4 and Expand URL tools back — no install, nothing to set up.
The full APK keeps every tool exactly as it was. The page decides from where it is served, and an installed app is never a web page, so nothing about a sideloaded or over-the-air install changed.
The version line names the build you are running — Full, Play or Web — so a tool that seems to be missing can be checked against the build actually installed.
